name: TwistingData.card_le_finrank_translatesIn
summary: The residues of the columns j ∈ s are |s| linearly independent elements of the space on the right: they lie there by hs, and R recovers each coefficient of a vanishing combination.

steps.claim: Consider the family j ↦ (x ↦ residue of Q_{(x,·),j}), j ∈ s; each value lies in translatesIn (T mod 𝔪) n G ⊥ B, since reduction modulo 𝔪 commutes with ρ (letterRep_map) and the entries of ρ(g)Q_{(x,·),j} at β ∈ B lie in 𝔪 (hs). It suffices that this family is linearly independent (then |s| is at most the dimension).
steps.lean:
card_coe s ▸ LinearIndependent.fintype_card_le_finrank (b := fun j x ↦ ⟨residue O ∘ Q.col j ∘ (x,
  ·), by simp_all [translatesIn, letterRep_map, ← map_sum]⟩)

steps.claim: If Σ_j g_j·(residue of column j) = 0, apply Σ_y residue(R_{iy})·(…)_y: by (RQ)_{ij} = δ_{ij} (h) this gives g_i = 0.
steps.lean:
(linearIndependent_iff.2 fun g hg i ↦ by simpa [mul_sum _, sum_comm, mul_left_comm, h,
  ← mul_sum, ← map_sum] using congr(∑ y, residue O (R i y) * ($hg y.1).1 y.2))
